title: Adjunctive therapeutic strategy for in-stent thrombosis: in vitro pharmacodynamic evaluation of COX-1 inhibitor 3d combined with catheter-directed thrombolysis

Twelve benzohydrazide Schiff base derivatives (3a–3l) with systematic variations in the aromatic aldehyde moiety were designed and synthesized to evaluate their anti-inflammatory, antiplatelet, and in vitro antithrombotic activities.
